statement: Original M3_k2 converged with N_complete=423, six binary indicators and report_candidate=0. The historical screen limits candidates to four or five classes.
One original-specification replay converged with N423, rank13 and 14 slots; no refit or predictions.
Original native comparison remains 217 cells, 34 exact matches, 183 differences and zero stripe mismatches.
Class swap strongly explains the dominant difference; small residual coefficient/covariance/distribution differences remain. Approximate diagnostic alignment is not exact replication.
The first class-membership intercept is fixed to zero as the reference. Both mixture weights remain functions of the free intercept; neither probability is fixed by that constraint.
Historical likelihood, df, AIC and BIC are archival grid values. Fresh replay information criteria were not recomputed; context is not a new candidate ranking.
Historical entropy, posterior summary and class sizes are archival grid diagnostics, not fresh replay predictions.
Both distribution Jacobians and free covariance matrices have numerical rank13 at four relative thresholds. This is fitted-point numerical evidence under the assumed model.
Stored gradients are finite; stored H is absent in both states. No fresh scores or Hessian were evaluated.
Exact historical numerical identity remains unaccepted; no acceptance tolerance, native target substitution or saved-state rewriting.
Measurement validity, global identification/optimality, robustness, substantive class interpretation and scientific use are not accepted by this disposition.
Replay report_candidate and posterior metrics were not recomputed. Never present the archival flag or metrics as new replay outputs.
Unavailable Hessian diagnostics must not become zero; historical missing-value screen caveat remains unchanged.
The archival reporting screen is not a BIC-minimization or universal scientific-validity rule. M3_k2 exclusion does not imply nonconvergence or intrinsic invalidity.
Do not rank M3 and H1 by their absolute BIC/AIC values: their outcome/feature structures differ.
The separately selected historical hybrid H1_k4 model is not changed or substituted for M3_k2.
Preserve M3_k5 archived rc0/convergence0 and blank likelihood/information/posterior/class-size fields. Missing failed-candidate values are not zero or newly evaluated failures.
No new Stata call, fit, prediction, participant-data load, production edit, manuscript edit, Git/cloud change or release is authorized.
